name: game-postmortem
description: > Run a structured post-mortem analyzing what went well, what went wrong, and extractable lessons. Pulls git history, milestone data, and retrospective notes automatically. Triggers on: "post-mortem", "project review", "what did we learn", "lessons learned", or when a major milestone or project is complete. Do NOT invoke for sprint-level retrospectives (use game-retrospective) or design reviews (use game-design-review). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.
author: AlterLab-IEU
